description: This Java source file defines a Spring Web MVC configuration class that sets up Thymeleaf templating and Spring Security integration.

classes.name: WebConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class that implements WebMvcConfigurer and ApplicationContextAware to set up view resolution and argument resolvers.

methods.name: addArgumentResolvers
methods.description: Adds an AuthenticationPrincipalArgumentResolver to the list of argument resolvers, configuring it with the application context.

methods.name: setApplicationContext
methods.description: Sets the Spring application context for use within the configuration.

methods.name: templateResolver
methods.description: Defines a SpringResourceTemplateResolver bean for resolving Thymeleaf templates from /WEB-INF/templates/.

methods.name: templateEngine
methods.description: Defines a SpringTemplateEngine bean configured with the template resolver and Spring Security dialect.

methods.name: viewResolver
methods.description: Defines a ThymeleafViewResolver bean that uses the SpringTemplateEngine for rendering views.
